context: Evaluates correct implementation of graceful shutdown for a Node.js HTTP server including OS signal handling, connection draining, and ordered resource cleanup. The candidate must handle SIGTERM and SIGINT, stop accepting new connections, drain in-flight requests, close external connections, and exit with the right code.

checklist.name: SIGTERM and SIGINT handlers
checklist.description: Registers handlers for both process.on('SIGTERM') and process.on('SIGINT') — not just one signal

checklist.name: server.close() call
checklist.description: Calls server.close() to stop accepting new connections as the first step in the shutdown sequence

checklist.name: Drain before close
checklist.description: Awaits in-flight request completion before closing external resources (e.g. uses server.close() callback or close-with-grace)

checklist.name: Ordered resource cleanup
checklist.description: Closes the database connection only after server.close() completes, maintaining the correct shutdown order

checklist.name: process.exit() with correct code
checklist.description: Calls process.exit(0) on success and process.exit(1) if shutdown throws, not relying on natural process exit
